title: A colour grade can be its own track over the clips below it, with a blend mode and a matte
goal: The compositing mock puts a colour grade on its own track (V4) above the picture, tinting everything under it through a blend mode, and shows only where a matte layer lets it, so a whole scene or one region of it can be graded at once. Today a grade is only an effect on one clip.
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video-compositing.html lines 262 (layer list Colour grade screen), 287 (grade.look preset), 306 (add menu Colour grade), 346 (V4 colour grade track), 377-443 (blend swatches, matte masking). The per-clip Color Grade effect landed in task a-clip-can-be-colour-graded-from-add-effect: ColorGradeEffect (PhotonzCore/ColorGrade.swift) and ColorGradeFilter (PhotonzRender) can be reused as the adjustment the layer applies to the composite below it. The grade.look Library preset is part of this too.
acceptance: A Colour grade item can be added to its own track above other clips, and grades every picture below it while it is on the timeline
Its Blending picks how it combines with what is under it, as the mock swatches show
With a matte layer under it, the grade shows only where the matte lets it, and a keyed matte shape animates the reveal
A walk at Next defaults measures the frame graded under the grade layer and ungraded outside its matte
